plugins.name: adlicio
plugins.description: Give the agent real customer language. Scrape comments and reviews from Reddit, YouTube, Amazon, TikTok, Instagram, Trustpilot, app stores and 20+ other sources, search Reddit and YouTube, pull top-performing TikTok and Instagram videos with their hooks, find competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library, and build brand and voice-of-customer reports. Remote MCP with OAuth, no API keys to paste.
